exercises.why: **напоминайте** — напомина́ть (imperfective): to remind (cause one to experience a memory; bring to a person's notice); to resemble, to look like. Wiktionary: на- + помина́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **забыл** — забы́ть (perfective): to forget; to neglect; to leave, to forget to bring, to forget to take; to let it go, to let it slip. Wiktionary: за- + быть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to remind (cause one to experience a memory; bring to a person's notice)
to notice, to remark, to note, to observe
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: наблюда́ть — to watch, to observe; напомина́ть — to remind (cause one to experience a memory; bring to a person's notice); заме́тить — to notice, to remark, to note, to observe; забы́ть — to forget.

**заговорил** — заговори́ть (perfective): to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk); to exorcise, to bewitch, to charm, to cast a spell, to enchant. Wiktionary: за- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to compel, to force, to make
to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: заговори́ть — to begin to speak; заста́вить — to compel, to force, to make; закрича́ть — to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout; за́пах — smell, odor, scent (sensation).
**Заставь** — заста́вить (perfective): to compel, to force, to make; to fill, to cram, to jam, to clutter; to block up, to close off. Wiktionary: за- + ста́вить.

exercises.why: **занимаю** — занима́ть (imperfective): to borrow; to occupy, to take up; to employ, to busy; to reserve, to secure, to keep. Wiktionary: за- + -нима́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Tom has a lot of brains.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to want, to begin to desire
to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: засмея́ться — to laugh, to start laughing; захоте́ть — to begin to want, to begin to desire; занима́ть — to borrow; зайти́ — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in.
